good_primary_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

good_unique_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN handles u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

good_composite_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN pairs u ON u.id = p.author_id AND u.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.id >= 100

good_chained_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id JOIN handles h ON h.id = u.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

good_left_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

good_values_window.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (fn_min_uuidv7(now() - '7 days'::interval))) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.column1

good_named_values_window.definition: WITH w(cutoff) AS (VALUES (fn_min_uuidv7(now() - '7 days'::interval))) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.cutoff

good_constant_window.definition: WITH w AS (SELECT fn_min_uuidv7(now() - '7 days'::interval) AS cutoff) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.cutoff

good_days_window.definition: WITH w(days) AS (VALUES (7)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p CROSS JOIN w WHERE p.created_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - w.days * INTERVAL '1 day'

good_cte_lookup.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (fn_min_uuidv7(now() - '7 days'::interval))) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.column1 JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_nonleading_window.definition: SELECT id FROM pairs WHERE id >= fn_min_uuidv7(now() - '7 days'::interval)

bad_partial_composite_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN pairs u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_partial_unique_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN partial_users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_unbounded_driver.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_or_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id OR u.author_id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_self_join.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN posts u ON u.author_id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_multiple_values.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100), (200)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.column1

bad_cte_table_read.definition: WITH w AS (SELECT id AS cutoff FROM users) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.cutoff

bad_cte_subquery.definition: WITH w AS (SELECT (SELECT min(id) FROM users) AS cutoff) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.cutoff

bad_cte_function.definition: WITH w AS (SELECT generate_series(1, 10) AS cutoff) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.cutoff

bad_cte_shadow.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p WHERE EXISTS (WITH w AS (SELECT id AS column1 FROM users) SELECT 1 FROM posts q JOIN w ON q.id >= w.column1)

bad_alias_shadow.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users w ON p.id >= w.id

bad_preserved_join.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p FULL JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id AND p.id >= 100

bad_lookup_aggregate.definition: SELECT count(*) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_forward_cte.definition: WITH first AS (SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN bounds b ON p.id >= b.cutoff WHERE b.id >= 100), bounds(cutoff) AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT * FROM first

good_cte_alias.definition: WITH w(cutoff) AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w window_bound ON p.id >= window_bound.cutoff

bad_nullable_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN nullable_users u ON u.id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_nonunique_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.author_id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_constant_nonleading.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM pairs p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.column1

bad_cte_qualified_shadow.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN public.bounds w ON p.id >= w.cutoff WHERE w.id >= 100

good_unique_index_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN indexed_users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

good_using_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u USING (id) WHERE p.id >= 100

good_or_key_lookup.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100 AND (u.id = p.id OR u.id = p.author_id)

good_constant_aliased_window.definition: WITH w(cutoff) AS (SELECT 100) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON w.cutoff <= p.id

good_quoted_window.definition: WITH "Window"("Cutoff") AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN "Window" "W" ON p.id >= "W"."Cutoff"

bad_quoted_window_case.definition: WITH "Window"("Cutoff") AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN "Window" "W" ON p.id >= "W".cutoff

bad_lookup_range.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id >= p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100

bad_limit.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id LIMIT 10

bad_partial_implied.definition: SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN partial_users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.id >= 100 AND u.id > 0

good_nullable_cte.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p LEFT JOIN w ON true WHERE p.id >= w.column1

bad_preserved_cte.definition: WITH w AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p LEFT JOIN w ON p.id >= w.column1

bad_recursive_cte.definition: WITH RECURSIVE w(cutoff) AS (VALUES (100)) SELECT p.id FROM posts p JOIN w ON p.id >= w.cutoff

good_cte_driver.definition: WITH recent AS (SELECT p.id, p.author_id FROM posts p WHERE p.id >= 100) SELECT p.id FROM recent p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

good_derived_driver.definition: SELECT p.id FROM (SELECT id, author_id FROM posts WHERE id >= 100) p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_aggregate_driver.definition: SELECT p.id FROM (SELECT min(id) AS id, min(author_id) AS author_id FROM posts) p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_limited_driver.definition: SELECT p.id FROM (SELECT id, author_id FROM posts LIMIT 10) p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_cte_driver.definition: WITH recent AS (SELECT p.id, p.author_id FROM posts p) SELECT p.id FROM recent p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id

bad_expanding_driver.definition: SELECT u.id FROM (SELECT get_all_user_ids() AS id FROM posts p WHERE p.id >= 100) d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.id
